fields.title: Share MOSS and Pocket sidecar process and request handling
fields.description: Extract duplicated process startup, JSON-lines message handling, request correlation, timeout, cancellation and shutdown from main/moss-nano-sidecar.js and main/pocket-tts-sidecar.js into one shared implementation parameterized by provider settings.
fields.notes:
Owner-requested roadmap addition, 2026-09-23. Blocked behind full mode separation; beyond current five-item priority sequence. Planning stub, not dispatch-ready. Approx. 650 net lines saved across all five items is the owner's unverified aggregate estimate; expected dependency-count delta 0. No code changes or provider activation authorized by this planning update.
Keep exported adapter factories compatible and provider entry points thin. Preserve distinct Python/script/model paths, arguments, environment, readiness/failure payloads and timeout values. Each adapter owns a separate child process, pending map, request IDs and timers. Sharing implementation must not share mutable runtime state. Both providers remain dormant; no engine activation or reading-mode behavior changes.
Verification to specify: tests/mossNanoEngine.test.js and tests/pocketTtsEngine.test.js plus two simultaneous provider instances, interleaved responses, timeout, cancel, spawn/exit failure and shutdown isolation. Specify exact new helper/test targets at dispatch.

fields.title: Share cloud retry handling with provider token refresh
fields.description: Replace duplicated withRetry loops in main/cloud-google.js and main/cloud-onedrive.js with a shared helper that receives the provider token-refresh function.
fields.notes:
Owner-requested roadmap addition, 2026-09-23. Blocked behind full mode separation; beyond current five-item priority sequence. Planning stub, not dispatch-ready. Approx. 650 net lines saved across all five items is the owner's unverified aggregate estimate; expected dependency-count delta 0. No code changes or provider activation authorized by this planning update.
Preserve current 429/503/504 capped exponential backoff and attempt count; 401 calls the correct force-refresh provider and retries only when attempt is zero. Keep original-error behavior on refresh failure and fail-fast behavior for other errors. Keep Google/Microsoft credentials separate, and leave provider HTTP/upload/conditional-write semantics unchanged.
Verification to specify: tests/cloudGoogle.test.js and tests/cloudOnedrive.test.js plus a shared-helper matrix for retryable statuses, 401 first/later attempt, refresh failure, exhausted attempts and non-retryable errors, using deterministic timers.
